# SK9029 — The load names an analyzer or source generator assembly that is not on disk

<!-- Generated from Rules/Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata/rules.json. Do not edit. -->

The load names an analyzer or source generator assembly at a path that does not exist, so whatever it would have contributed — generated types included — is absent from the compilation. Under `--load=workspace` this refuses the load: the units are emptied, not merely flagged, and the run exits 4. Under `--load=binlog` it is a warning and the load proceeds. Build the `Debug` configuration, which is what `MSBuildWorkspace` evaluates, or use `--load=binlog`, which reads what a build actually compiled.

|---|---|

## Why

#336, and it is the worst shape a silence can take: not a missing finding but a wrong one, carrying a fix that breaks the build. A fresh clone built only in `Release`, read through the workspace, reported 353 files to rewrite — every finding `SK0210` usings — and the same clone through a binlog reported 0. Neither generator had run, so `RuleCatalog` and every `Rikarin.Skala.Options` type did not exist, and `SK0210` was correct about the compilation it was handed: taking its advice deletes `using Rikarin.Skala.Rules.Metadata;` from a file that calls `RuleCatalog.All`. The absent file is the signal, not a failure to load one — `SK9031` covers an assembly that is present and throws, and is never fatal — and withdrawing only the affected rules is not decidable, since no rule declares which symbols it depends on. The binlog case differs in kind: its paths come off a command line `csc` actually ran, so the assembly did its work and the tree was cleaned afterwards, the same class of fact as `SK9020`.

## When it does not fire

On the binlog path the diagnostic's file is the compilation's assembly name rather than a path, and may be empty. The first diagnosis of #336 blamed the `SK9024` `project reference without a matching metadata reference` lines, and 44 of the 353 files referenced no such project at all; those lines are benign and remain after the fix.
